records.literal_gloss: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones and your sojourner who [is] in your gates, so that they may hear and so that they may learn, and they will fear Yahweh your God and take care to do all [the] words of the law the this.

en.L: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and your sojourner who [is] within your gates, so that they may hear and so that they may learn, and fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and take care to do all the words of this law.
en.B: Gather the people together, men, women and children, and the outsiders who live in your towns, so that they may hear and learn, and fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and carefully obey all the words of this law.
en.R: Bring all the people together: men, women, children, and the outsiders living in your towns. Then they will hear and learn to fear and honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. They will be careful to obey everything this teaching says.

es.L: Reúne al pueblo, a los hombres y a las mujeres y a los niños pequeños, y a tu extranjero que [está] dentro de tus puertas, para que oigan y para que aprendan, y teman {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, y cuiden de poner por obra todas las palabras de esta ley.
es.B: Congrega al pueblo, hombres, mujeres y niños, y a los inmigrantes que viven en tus ciudades, para que escuchen y aprendan, y teman {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, y obedezcan con cuidado todas las palabras de esta ley.
es.R: Reúne a todo el pueblo: hombres, mujeres, niños y los extranjeros que viven en tus ciudades. Así oirán y aprenderán a temer y honrar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}. Tendrán cuidado de obedecer todo lo que dice esta enseñanza.

fr.L: Rassemble le peuple, les hommes et les femmes et les petits enfants, et ton immigré qui [est] dans tes portes, afin qu’ils entendent et afin qu’ils apprennent, et qu’ils craignent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, et qu’ils veillent à pratiquer toutes les paroles de cette loi.
fr.B: Réunis le peuple, hommes, femmes et enfants, ainsi que les immigrés qui vivent dans tes villes, afin qu’ils entendent et qu’ils apprennent à craindre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, et qu’ils mettent soigneusement en pratique toutes les paroles de cette loi.
fr.R: Rassemble tout le peuple : les hommes, les femmes, les enfants, et les étrangers qui vivent dans tes villes. Alors ils entendront et apprendront à craindre et à honorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. Ils feront attention à obéir à tout ce que dit cet enseignement.

sw.L: Wakusanye watu, wanaume na wanawake na watoto wadogo, na mgeni wako aliye malangoni mwako, ili wasikie na ili wajifunze, na wamche {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, na waangalie kutenda maneno yote ya sheria hii.
sw.B: Wakusanye watu, wanaume, wanawake na watoto, pamoja na wageni wanaoishi katika miji yako, ili wasikie na kujifunza kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, na kuyashika kwa uangalifu maneno yote ya sheria hii.
sw.R: Wakusanye watu wote: wanaume, wanawake, watoto, na wageni wanaoishi katika miji yako. Ndipo watasikia na kujifunza kumcha na kumheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu. Watakuwa waangalifu kutii yote yaliyomo katika mafundisho haya.

decisions.choice: the little ones: the children
decisions.reason: The word means small children, those too young to march or fight. The whole community is gathered, not only the men.

decisions.choice: sojourner: a foreigner living among Israel
decisions.reason: The word names someone from another people who has settled among Israel without land of his own, and whom the law protects (10:18-19; 14:29). Such people also hear the law.

decisions.choice: fear the LORD and take care to do: reverence that shows in obedience
decisions.reason: To fear the LORD is to hold him in awe and respect, and Deuteronomy ties it to keeping his words (4:10; 6:2, 24). Hearing leads to learning, learning to fear, and fear to obedience.

decisions.choice: the outsiders who live in your towns
decisions.reason: "Sojourner" is uncommon in modern English. "Your gates" means your towns, whose gates were where public life went on.

decisions.choice: fear and honor
decisions.reason: Readable adds "honor" so that "fear" is not taken as mere terror, as in 17:19.

source.text: וּבְנֵיהֶ֞ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־יָדְע֗וּ יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ וְלָ֣מְד֔וּ לְיִרְאָ֖ה אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם כָּל־הַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֤ם חַיִּים֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And their children who not have known will hear and learn to fear Yahweh your God all the days which you [are] alive on the land which you [are] crossing the Jordan there to possess it.

en.L: And their children, who have not known [it], will hear and learn to fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God all the days that you live on the land that you are crossing the Jordan to take possession of [it]."
en.B: Their children, who do not yet know it, will hear it too and learn to fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God for as long as you live in the land you are crossing the Jordan to take possession of."
en.R: Their children, who have never heard it, will hear it too. They will learn to fear and honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God for as long as you live in the land across the Jordan River that you are going to take as your own."

es.L: Y sus hijos, que no [la] han conocido, oirán y aprenderán a temer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} todos los días que {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}} sobre la tierra a la que {{plural_you:pasan|pasáis}} el Jordán para tomar posesión de ella».
es.B: Sus hijos, que todavía no la conocen, también la oirán y aprenderán a temer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} mientras {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}} en la tierra que {{plural_you:van|vais}} a poseer al otro lado del Jordán».
es.R: Sus hijos, que nunca la han oído, también la oirán. Aprenderán a temer y honrar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} mientras {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}} en la tierra al otro lado del río Jordán que {{plural_you:van|vais}} a tomar como suya».

fr.L: Et leurs enfants, qui n’ont pas connu [cela], entendront et apprendront à craindre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu tous les jours que vous vivrez sur la terre où vous allez passer le Jourdain pour en prendre possession. »
fr.B: Leurs enfants, qui ne la connaissent pas encore, l’entendront eux aussi et apprendront à craindre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, aussi longtemps que vous vivrez dans le pays dont vous allez prendre possession en passant le Jourdain. »
fr.R: Leurs enfants, qui ne l’ont jamais entendu, l’entendront eux aussi. Ils apprendront à craindre et à honorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, aussi longtemps que vous vivrez dans le pays de l’autre côté du Jourdain, que vous allez prendre pour vous. »

sw.L: Na watoto wao, ambao hawajajua, watasikia na kujifunza kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu siku zote mtakazoishi katika nchi mnayovuka Yordani kwenda huko kuimiliki."
sw.B: Watoto wao, ambao bado hawaijui, nao wataisikia na kujifunza kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu muda wote mtakaoishi katika nchi mnayovuka Yordani kwenda kuimiliki."
sw.R: Watoto wao, ambao hawajawahi kuyasikia, nao watayasikia. Watajifunza kumcha na kumheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu muda wote mtakaoishi katika nchi iliyo ng'ambo ya Mto Yordani, mnayokwenda kuichukua iwe yenu."

decisions.choice: who have not known: who do not yet know the law
decisions.reason: The verb has no object. The children have not yet come to know God's law, nor seen for themselves what God did for Israel (11:2). The public reading is how each new generation learns it.

decisions.choice: all the days you live: for as long as Israel lives in the land
decisions.reason: "You" is plural and means Israel through its generations. The reading is to go on as long as the people live in the land.

decisions.choice: it
decisions.reason: English needs an object for "know". Literal brackets it.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה הֵ֣ן קָרְב֣וּ יָמֶיךָ֮ לָמוּת֒ קְרָ֣א אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וְהִֽתְיַצְּב֛וּ בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וַאֲצַוֶּ֑נּוּ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ מֹשֶׁה֙ וִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Moses, look, have drawn near your days to die; call Joshua and present yourselves at [the] tent of meeting, that I may commission him. And went Moses and Joshua and presented themselves at [the] tent of meeting.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "Look, your days to die have drawn near. Call Joshua, and present yourselves at the tent of meeting, that I may charge him." And Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the tent of meeting.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "The time of your death is near. Call Joshua, and the two of you come and stand at the tent of meeting, so that I can commission him." So Moses and Joshua went and took their places at the tent of meeting.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "You will soon die. Call Joshua, and come together to the meeting tent. There I will give him his orders." So Moses and Joshua went and stood at the meeting tent.

es.L: Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Moisés: «He aquí, se han acercado tus días para morir. Llama a Josué, y {{plural_you:preséntense|presentaos}} en la Tienda del Encuentro, para que yo le dé órdenes». Y fueron Moisés y Josué y se presentaron en la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Moisés: «Se acerca el momento de tu muerte. Llama a Josué, y {{plural_you:vengan|venid}} los dos a ponerse en la Tienda del Encuentro, para que yo le encomiende su cargo». Así que Moisés y Josué fueron y se colocaron en la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Moisés: «Pronto vas a morir. Llama a Josué, y {{plural_you:vengan|venid}} juntos a la Tienda del Encuentro. Allí le daré su encargo». Entonces Moisés y Josué fueron y se pusieron de pie en la Tienda del Encuentro.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « Voici, tes jours se sont approchés pour mourir. Appelle Josué, et présentez-vous à la tente de la Rencontre, afin que je lui donne mes ordres. » Et Moïse et Josué allèrent et se présentèrent à la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « Le moment de ta mort est proche. Appelle Josué, et venez tous deux vous tenir à la tente de la Rencontre, afin que je lui confie sa charge. » Moïse et Josué allèrent donc prendre place à la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Moïse : « Tu vas bientôt mourir. Appelle Josué, et venez ensemble à la tente de la Rencontre. Là, je lui donnerai sa mission. » Alors Moïse et Josué y sont allés et se sont tenus à la tente de la Rencontre.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Musa, "Tazama, siku zako za kufa zimekaribia. Mwite Yoshua, mkasimame katika Hema la Kukutania, ili nimwagize." Basi Musa na Yoshua wakaenda, wakasimama katika Hema la Kukutania.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa, "Wakati wa kufa kwako umekaribia. Mwite Yoshua, mje ninyi wawili msimame katika Hema la Kukutania, ili nimkabidhi jukumu lake." Basi Musa na Yoshua walikwenda, wakasimama katika Hema la Kukutania.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa, "Utakufa hivi karibuni. Mwite Yoshua, mje pamoja kwenye Hema la Kukutania. Huko nitampa jukumu lake." Basi Musa na Yoshua walikwenda, wakasimama kwenye Hema la Kukutania.

decisions.choice: commission him: charge him with his task and give him authority
decisions.reason: The verb means to command, and with a person as its object to appoint him to a work and give him his orders (3:28; Numbers 27:19, 23). God now does in person what Moses has done in verse 7. The commissioning itself is told in verse 23.

decisions.choice: present yourselves: take your stand before God
decisions.reason: The verb means to station oneself, to stand ready, used of standing before God to meet him (Exodus 19:17; 1 Samuel 10:19).

decisions.choice: the tent of meeting: where God met Moses
decisions.reason: The tent was where God met with Moses and spoke with him (Exodus 33:7-11). This is the only time Deuteronomy mentions it.

decisions.choice: the meeting tent
decisions.reason: Readable says "the meeting tent", as in Exodus and Numbers.

source.text: וַיֵּרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה בָּאֹ֖הֶל בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֑ן וַיַּעֲמֹ֛ד עַמּ֥וּד הֶעָנָ֖ן עַל־פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹֽהֶל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And appeared Yahweh at the tent in a pillar of cloud, and stood [the] pillar of the cloud over [the] entrance of the tent.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} appeared at the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the entrance of the tent.
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} appeared in a pillar of cloud at the tent, and the pillar stood over its entrance.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} appeared there in a tall column of cloud. The cloud stood at the entrance of the tent.

es.L: Y se apareció {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en la tienda en una columna de nube, y la columna de nube se detuvo sobre la entrada de la tienda.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se apareció en una columna de nube junto a la tienda, y la columna se posó sobre su entrada.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se apareció allí en una alta columna de nube. La nube se quedó a la entrada de la tienda.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} apparut à la tente dans une colonne de nuée, et la colonne de nuée se tint au-dessus de l’entrée de la tente.
fr.B: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} apparut dans une colonne de nuée à la tente, et la colonne se tint au-dessus de son entrée.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est apparu là dans une haute colonne de nuage. Le nuage s’est arrêté à l’entrée de la tente.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaonekana hemani katika nguzo ya wingu, nayo nguzo ya wingu ikasimama juu ya mlango wa hema.
sw.B: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alionekana katika nguzo ya wingu hemani, na nguzo hiyo ikasimama juu ya mlango wake.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alitokea hapo katika nguzo ndefu ya wingu. Wingu hilo lilisimama mlangoni pa hema.

decisions.choice: a pillar of cloud: the sign of God's presence
decisions.reason: The pillar of cloud led Israel out of Egypt and through the wilderness (Exodus 13:21-22), and it came down at the entrance of the tent when God spoke with Moses (Exodus 33:9-10; Numbers 12:5).

decisions.choice: over the entrance: above it, or at it
decisions.reason: The word can mean "over" or "by, at". Either way the cloud stands at the doorway of the tent, as in Exodus 33:9.

decisions.choice: a tall column of cloud
decisions.reason: Readable says "column" for "pillar", a plainer word for the same shape.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה הִנְּךָ֥ שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם־אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וְקָם֩ הָעָ֨ם הַזֶּ֜ה וְזָנָ֣ה׀אַחֲרֵ֣י׀אֱלֹהֵ֣י נֵֽכַר־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא בָא־שָׁ֨מָּה֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ וַעֲזָבַ֕נִי וְהֵפֵר֙ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אִתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Moses, look, you [are] lying down with your fathers, and will rise the people the this and will prostitute after [the] gods of [the] foreignness of the land which it [is] going there into its midst, and it will forsake me and break my covenant which I made with it.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "Look, you are about to lie down with your fathers, and this people will rise up and prostitute themselves after the foreign gods of the land into whose midst they are going, and they will forsake {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and break {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant that I made with them.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "You are about to rest with your ancestors. Then this people will rise up and prostitute themselves to the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will abandon {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and break {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant, which I made with them.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "You will soon die. After that, these people will be unfaithful to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, like a wife who leaves her husband for other men. They will chase after the gods of the foreign land they are going into. They will abandon {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and break the covenant I made with them.

es.L: Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Moisés: «He aquí, tú vas a yacer con tus padres, y este pueblo se levantará y se prostituirá tras los dioses extranjeros de la tierra en medio de la cual va a entrar, y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} abandonará y quebrantará {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto que hice con él.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Moisés: «Estás a punto de descansar con tus antepasados. Entonces este pueblo se levantará y se prostituirá con los dioses extranjeros de la tierra en la que va a entrar. Me abandonará y romperá {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto, el que hice con él.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Moisés: «Pronto vas a morir. Después, este pueblo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} será infiel, como una esposa que deja a su esposo por otros hombres. Se irá tras los dioses de la tierra extranjera adonde va a entrar. Me abandonará y romperá el pacto que hice con él.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « Voici, tu vas te coucher avec tes pères, et ce peuple se lèvera et se prostituera en suivant les dieux étrangers du pays au milieu duquel il va entrer, et il {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}abandonnera et rompra {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance, que j’ai conclue avec lui.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « Tu vas reposer avec tes {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}. Alors ce peuple se lèvera et se prostituera avec les dieux étrangers du pays où il va entrer. Il {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}abandonnera et rompra {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance, celle que j’ai conclue avec lui.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Moïse : « Tu vas bientôt mourir. Après cela, ce peuple {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sera infidèle, comme une femme qui quitte son mari pour d’autres hommes. Il courra après les dieux du pays étranger où il va entrer. Il {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}abandonnera et rompra l’alliance que j’ai faite avec lui.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Musa, "Tazama, wewe unakaribia kulala pamoja na baba zako, na watu hawa wataondoka na kufanya ukahaba kwa kuifuata miungu ya kigeni ya nchi wanayoiingia, nao wataniacha na kulivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} nililofanya nao.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa, "Unakaribia kupumzika pamoja na mababu zako. Kisha watu hawa wataanza kufanya ukahaba na miungu ya kigeni ya nchi wanayoiingia. Wataniacha na kulivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, nililofanya nao.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa, "Utakufa hivi karibuni. Baada ya hapo, watu hawa hawatakuwa waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, kama mke anayemwacha mume wake ili aende na wanaume wengine. Wataifuata miungu ya nchi ya kigeni wanayoiingia. Wataniacha na kulivunja agano nililofanya nao.

decisions.choice: lie down with your fathers: die
decisions.reason: To "lie down with" one's fathers is a common way of speaking of death (Genesis 47:30; 1 Kings 2:10).

decisions.choice: prostitute themselves: be unfaithful to God by worshiping other gods
decisions.reason: The verb means to act as a prostitute. The covenant is pictured as a marriage, so turning to other gods is unfaithfulness to God, who is like a husband to his people (Exodus 34:15-16; Judges 2:17; Hosea 2:4-7).

decisions.choice: it: the people as one body
decisions.reason: God speaks of "this people" with singular verbs and pronouns, "it will forsake me", as of one person. The sense is the whole people together.

decisions.choice: break my covenant: undo the covenant from Israel's side
decisions.reason: The verb means to break or make void. The covenant God made at Horeb and renewed in Moab (5:2; 28:69) binds Israel to worship God alone; turning to other gods breaks it (Leviticus 26:15).

decisions.choice: like a wife who leaves her husband for other men
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture behind "prostitute themselves" rather than using the word, which young readers may not understand in this sense.

decisions.choice: rest with your ancestors
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the gentle picture of death as lying down, with "rest". Literal keeps "lie down with your fathers".

decisions.choice: "este pueblo ... abandonará ... hice con él", singular, as the Hebrew
alternatives: plural "abandonarán ... con ellos", as the English
decisions.reason: "Pueblo" is singular in Spanish, so the Hebrew singular (see the meaning decision) reads naturally; the English needs "they".

decisions.choice: "ce peuple ... il m'abandonnera ... avec lui", singular, as the Hebrew
alternatives: plural "ils m'abandonneront ... avec eux", as the English
decisions.reason: "Peuple" is singular in French, so the Hebrew singular (see the meaning decision) reads naturally; the English needs "they".

source.text: וְחָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֣י ב֣וֹ בַיּוֹם־הַ֠הוּא וַעֲזַבְתִּ֞ים וְהִסְתַּרְתִּ֨י פָנַ֤י מֵהֶם֙ וְהָיָ֣ה לֶֽאֱכֹ֔ל וּמְצָאֻ֛הוּ רָע֥וֹת רַבּ֖וֹת וְצָר֑וֹת וְאָמַר֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא הֲלֹ֗א עַ֣ל כִּֽי־אֵ֤ין אֱלֹהַי֙ בְּקִרְבִּ֔י מְצָא֖וּנִי הָרָע֥וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will burn my anger against it on the day the that, and I will forsake them and hide my face from them, and it will be for devouring, and will find it evils many and troubles; and it will say on the day the that, [is it] not because not my God [is] in my midst [that] have found me the evils the these?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger will burn against them on that day, and I will forsake them and hide {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face from them, and they will be [given over] to be devoured, and many evils and troubles will find them. And they will say on that day, 'Is it not because my God [is] not in my midst [that] these evils have found me?'
en.B: On that day {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger will blaze against them. I will abandon them and hide {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face from them, and they will be devoured. Many disasters and troubles will overtake them, and on that day they will say, 'Have these disasters not come on us because our God is no longer with us?'
en.R: When that happens, I will be very angry with them. I will leave them and turn away from them. They will be destroyed, and many terrible troubles will come on them. Then they will say, 'These troubles have come on us because our God is not with us anymore!'

es.L: Y se encenderá {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira contra él en aquel día, y los abandonaré y esconderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro de ellos, y será [entregado] para ser devorado, y lo alcanzarán muchos males y angustias. Y dirá en aquel día: “¿No [es] porque mi Dios no [está] en medio de mí [que] me han alcanzado estos males?”.
es.B: Aquel día {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira se encenderá contra ellos. Los abandonaré y esconderé de ellos {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro, y serán devorados. Muchas desgracias y angustias caerán sobre ellos, y aquel día dirán: “¿No nos han venido estas desgracias porque nuestro Dios ya no está con nosotros?”.
es.R: Cuando eso pase, me enojaré mucho con ellos. Los dejaré y me apartaré de ellos. Serán destruidos, y les vendrán muchos problemas terribles. Entonces dirán: “¡Estas desgracias nos han venido porque nuestro Dios ya no está con nosotros!”.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère s’enflammera contre lui en ce jour-là ; je les abandonnerai et je leur cacherai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} visage, et il sera [livré] pour être dévoré, et des maux nombreux et des détresses l’atteindront. Et il dira en ce jour-là : “N’est-ce pas parce que mon Dieu n’[est] pas au milieu de moi [que] ces maux m’ont atteint ?”
fr.B: En ce jour-là, {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère s’embrasera contre eux. Je les abandonnerai et je leur cacherai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} visage, et ils seront dévorés. Des malheurs et des détresses sans nombre s’abattront sur eux, et ce jour-là ils diront : “N’est-ce pas parce que notre Dieu n’est plus avec nous que ces malheurs nous sont arrivés ?”
fr.R: Quand cela arrivera, je serai très en colère contre eux. Je les abandonnerai et je me détournerai d’eux. Ils seront détruits, et beaucoup de terribles malheurs leur arriveront. Alors ils diront : “Ces malheurs nous sont arrivés parce que notre Dieu n’est plus avec nous !”

sw.L: Na hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itawaka juu yao siku hiyo, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawaacha na kuwaficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nao watakuwa [tayari] kuliwa, na mabaya mengi na taabu zitawapata. Nao watasema siku hiyo, 'Je, si kwa sababu Mungu wangu hayumo kati yangu, mabaya haya yamenipata?'
sw.B: Siku hiyo hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itawaka juu yao. Nitawaacha na kuwaficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nao wataangamizwa. Maafa mengi na taabu zitawapata, na siku hiyo watasema, 'Je, maafa haya hayajatupata kwa sababu Mungu wetu hayuko tena pamoja nasi?'
sw.R: Hilo litakapotokea, nitawakasirikia sana. Nitawaacha na kuwageuzia mgongo. Wataangamizwa, na taabu nyingi mbaya zitawapata. Ndipo watasema, 'Taabu hizi zimetupata kwa sababu Mungu wetu hayuko nasi tena!'

decisions.choice: hide my face: withdraw my favor and help
decisions.reason: When God's face shines on his people he blesses and protects them (Numbers 6:25-26). To hide his face is to turn away and leave them without his help (32:20; Isaiah 54:8).

decisions.choice: for devouring: to be eaten up, destroyed
decisions.reason: The people will become prey to be devoured. The verse does not say by whom; the curses of 28:25-68 and the Song (32:23-25) speak of enemies, hunger and disease.

decisions.choice: my God, my midst, found me: the people speaking as one
decisions.reason: As in verse 16, the people are one body, and in their complaint they say "my God" and "found me". The sense is "our God" and "found us".

decisions.choice: our God is not with us: true, but only half the truth
decisions.reason: The people will see that God has left them, but verse 18 gives the reason they leave out: he hides his face because they turned to other gods.

decisions.choice: us, our
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the plural, which says what the singular means when the people speak as one. Literal keeps the singular.

decisions.choice: turn away from them
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom "hide my face"; Literal and Balanced keep it.

source.text: וְאָנֹכִ֗י הַסְתֵּ֨ר אַסְתִּ֤יר פָּנַי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא עַ֥ל כָּל־הָרָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה כִּ֣י פָנָ֔ה אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And I, hiding I will hide my face on the day the that, because of all the evil which it has done, for it has turned to gods other.

en.L: And I will surely hide {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face on that day because of all the evil that they have done, for they have turned to other gods.
en.B: Yes, I will certainly hide {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face on that day because of all the evil they have done in turning to other gods.
en.R: I will surely turn away from them at that time, because of all the evil they have done by worshiping other gods.

es.L: Y yo ciertamente esconderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro en aquel día por todo el mal que ha hecho, porque se ha vuelto a otros dioses.
es.B: Sí, aquel día esconderé por completo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro por todo el mal que habrán hecho al volverse a otros dioses.
es.R: Sin duda, en ese tiempo me apartaré de ellos, por todo el mal que habrán hecho al adorar a otros dioses.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je cacherai certainement {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} visage en ce jour-là, à cause de tout le mal qu’il a fait, car il s’est tourné vers d’autres dieux.
fr.B: Oui, je cacherai vraiment {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} visage en ce jour-là, à cause de tout le mal qu’ils auront fait en se tournant vers d’autres dieux.
fr.R: Oui, à ce moment-là, je me détournerai d’eux, à cause de tout le mal qu’ils auront fait en adorant d’autres dieux.

sw.L: Nami hakika nitauficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} siku hiyo, kwa sababu ya maovu yote waliyoyatenda, kwa kuwa wameigeukia miungu mingine.
sw.B: Ndiyo, siku hiyo hakika nitauficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwa sababu ya uovu wote watakaokuwa wameufanya kwa kuigeukia miungu mingine.
sw.R: Hakika wakati huo nitawageuzia mgongo, kwa sababu ya uovu wote watakaokuwa wameufanya kwa kuabudu miungu mingine.

decisions.choice: I will surely hide: strong emphasis
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets "I" first and doubles the verb, "hiding I will hide". God answers the people's complaint (verse 17): yes, he has hidden his face, and he has done it on purpose.

decisions.choice: for it has turned: what the evil is
decisions.reason: The last clause names the evil they have done: turning to other gods.

decisions.choice: worshiping
decisions.reason: Readable says what "turning to" other gods means.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּתְב֤וּ לָכֶם֙ אֶת־הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את וְלַמְּדָ֥הּ אֶת־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שִׂימָ֣הּ בְּפִיהֶ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן תִּהְיֶה־לִּ֜י הַשִּׁירָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את לְעֵ֖ד בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And now write for yourselves the song the this and teach it [to] the sons of Israel; put it in their mouths, so that may be for me the song the this as a witness against [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And now write for yourselves this song, and teach it to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel; put it in their mouths, so that this song may be for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a witness against the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: So now write down this song for yourselves, and teach it to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. Put it on their lips, so that this song will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} witness against the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: Now write down this song, both of you, and teach it to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. Help them learn it by heart, so that this song will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} witness against them.

es.L: Y ahora, {{plural_you:escriban|escribid}} para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} este cántico, y enséñalo a los hijos de Israel; ponlo en su boca, para que este cántico sea para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} un testigo contra los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Así que ahora {{plural_you:escriban|escribid}} este cántico para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y enséñalo a los israelitas. Ponlo en sus labios, para que este cántico sea {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} testigo contra los israelitas.
es.R: Ahora {{plural_you:escriban|escribid}} los dos esta canción y {{plural_you:enséñenla|enseñadla}} a los israelitas. {{plural_you:Ayúdenlos|Ayudadlos}} a aprenderla de memoria, para que esta canción sea {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} testigo contra ellos.

fr.L: Et maintenant, écrivez pour vous ce cantique et enseigne-le aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël ; mets-le dans leur bouche, afin que ce cantique soit pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un témoin contre les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, écrivez ce cantique pour vous, et enseigne-le aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Mets-le sur leurs lèvres, afin que ce cantique soit {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} témoin contre les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: Maintenant, écrivez tous les deux ce chant et enseignez-le aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Aidez-les à l’apprendre par cœur, afin que ce chant soit {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} témoin contre eux.

sw.L: Basi sasa, jiandikieni wimbo huu, na uwafundishe wana wa Israeli; uutie vinywani mwao, ili wimbo huu uwe {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} shahidi dhidi ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Basi sasa jiandikieni wimbo huu, na uwafundishe Waisraeli. Uutie midomoni mwao, ili wimbo huu uwe shahidi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi ya Waisraeli.
sw.R: Sasa ninyi wawili uandikeni wimbo huu, mkawafundishe Waisraeli. Wasaidieni kuujua kwa moyo, ili wimbo huu uwe shahidi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi yao.

decisions.choice: write: plural; teach and put: singular
decisions.reason: "Write" is plural and speaks to Moses and Joshua together. "Teach" and "put" are singular and speak to Moses, who writes and teaches the song in verse 22.

decisions.choice: put it in their mouths: make them able to recite it
decisions.reason: The people are to know the song so well that they can say it from memory.

decisions.choice: a witness: one who testifies in a covenant dispute
decisions.reason: When Israel breaks the covenant, the song will speak against them as a witness in court, as heaven and earth (30:19; 31:28) and the book of the law (verse 26) will. The song itself calls heaven and earth to listen (32:1).

decisions.choice: both of you
decisions.reason: Readable shows that "write" is plural, spoken to Moses and Joshua.

decisions.choice: put it on their lips / help them learn it by heart
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture with a more natural English phrase; Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "cántico" (L, B), "canción" (R) for the Song of Moses
decisions.reason: "Cántico" is the usual word for a sacred song and is used again for this Song in verses 22 and 30; Readable uses the everyday word.

decisions.choice: plural "enséñenla", "ayúdenlos" at Readable
decisions.reason: Readable's sentence begins with the plural "escriban los dos" and keeps it, as the English Readable does; Literal and Balanced follow the Hebrew singular for "teach" and "put".

decisions.choice: "cantique" (L, B), "chant" (R) for the Song of Moses
decisions.reason: "Cantique" is the usual French word for a sacred song (le cantique de Moïse); Readable uses the everyday word. Literal and Balanced follow the Hebrew number ("écrivez", then "enseigne-le"); Readable keeps the plural through the sentence.

source.text: כִּֽי־אֲבִיאֶ֜נּוּ אֶֽל־הָאֲדָמָ֣ה׀אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֗יו זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ וְאָכַ֥ל וְשָׂבַ֖ע וְדָשֵׁ֑ן וּפָנָ֞ה אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ וַעֲבָד֔וּם וְנִ֣אֲצ֔וּנִי וְהֵפֵ֖ר אֶת־בְּרִיתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: For I will bring it into the land which I swore to its fathers, flowing [with] milk and honey, and it will eat and be satisfied and grow fat, and it will turn to gods other and they will serve them, and they will spurn me and it will break my covenant.

en.L: For I will bring them into the land that I swore to their fathers, flowing [with] milk and honey, and they will eat and be satisfied and grow fat, and they will turn to other gods and serve them, and they will despise {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and break {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant.
en.B: For when I have brought them into the land flowing with milk and honey that I swore to give their ancestors, and they have eaten their fill and grown fat, they will turn to other gods and serve them. They will treat {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with contempt and break {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant.
en.R: I will bring them into the land I promised with an oath to give their ancestors, a land flowing with milk and honey. They will have plenty to eat and grow rich and comfortable. Then they will turn to other gods and worship them. They will reject {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and break {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant.

es.L: Porque los introduciré en la tierra que juré a sus padres, [tierra] que fluye leche y miel, y comerán y se saciarán y engordarán, y se volverán a otros dioses y les servirán, y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} despreciarán y quebrantarán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto.
es.B: Porque cuando los haya llevado a la tierra que fluye leche y miel, la que juré dar a sus antepasados, y hayan comido hasta saciarse y hayan engordado, se volverán a otros dioses y les servirán. Me tratarán con desprecio y quebrantarán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto.
es.R: Los llevaré a la tierra que prometí con juramento dar a sus antepasados, una tierra que fluye leche y miel. Tendrán comida de sobra, se volverán ricos y vivirán cómodos. Entonces se volverán a otros dioses y los adorarán. Me rechazarán y romperán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto.

fr.L: Car je les ferai entrer dans le pays que j’ai juré à leurs pères, [pays] où coulent le lait et le miel, et ils mangeront et seront rassasiés et engraisseront, et ils se tourneront vers d’autres dieux et les serviront, et ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} mépriseront et rompront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance.
fr.B: Car lorsque je les aurai fait entrer dans le pays où coulent le lait et le miel, que j’ai juré de donner à leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}, et qu’ils auront mangé à satiété et seront devenus gras, ils se tourneront vers d’autres dieux et les serviront. Ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} traiteront avec mépris et rompront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance.
fr.R: Je les ferai entrer dans le pays que j’ai promis par serment de donner à leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}, un pays où coulent le lait et le miel. Ils auront beaucoup à manger, ils deviendront riches et vivront dans le confort. Puis ils se tourneront vers d’autres dieux et les adoreront. Ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} rejetteront et rompront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance.

sw.L: Kwa maana nitawaingiza katika nchi niliyowaapia baba zao, [nchi] itiririkayo maziwa na asali, nao watakula na kushiba na kunenepa, nao wataigeukia miungu mingine na kuitumikia, nao watanidharau na kulivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana nitakapokuwa nimewaingiza katika nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, niliyowaapia mababu zao kwamba nitawapa, nao wakishakula na kushiba na kunenepa, wataigeukia miungu mingine na kuitumikia. Watanidharau na kulivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.R: Nitawaingiza katika nchi niliyoahidi kwa kiapo kuwapa mababu zao, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali. Watapata chakula kingi, watatajirika na kuishi kwa starehe. Kisha wataigeukia miungu mingine na kuiabudu. Watanikataa na kulivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.

decisions.choice: flowing with milk and honey: a rich and fertile land
decisions.reason: Milk from flocks and herds and honey from bees or fruit stand for a land of plenty (6:3; Exodus 3:8).

decisions.choice: eat and be satisfied and grow fat: prosperity that leads to forgetting God
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy warns that when Israel has plenty it may forget the God who gave it (6:10-12; 8:10-14). The Song says the same: "Jeshurun grew fat and kicked" (32:15).

decisions.choice: spurn: treat with contempt
decisions.reason: The verb means to despise or scorn, to treat as worthless (Numbers 14:11, 23).

decisions.choice: for: why the song is needed
decisions.reason: The verse gives the reason for the song in verse 19: God already knows what Israel will do in the land.

decisions.choice: grow rich and comfortable
decisions.reason: Readable explains "grow fat", a picture of wealth and ease.

source.text: וְ֠הָיָה כִּֽי־תִמְצֶ֨אןָ אֹת֜וֹ רָע֣וֹת רַבּוֹת֮ וְצָרוֹת֒ וְ֠עָנְתָה הַשִּׁירָ֨ה הַזֹּ֤את לְפָנָיו֙ לְעֵ֔ד כִּ֛י לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכַ֖ח מִפִּ֣י זַרְע֑וֹ כִּ֧י יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶת־יִצְר֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא עֹשֶׂה֙ הַיּ֔וֹם בְּטֶ֣רֶם אֲבִיאֶ֔נּוּ אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבָּֽעְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, when find it evils many and troubles, then will testify the song the this before it as a witness, for not it will be forgotten from [the] mouth of its offspring; for I know its inclination which it [is] doing today, before I bring it into the land which I swore.

en.L: And it will be, when many evils and troubles have found them, that this song will testify before them as a witness, for it will not be forgotten from the mouths of their offspring. For I know their inclination, which they are acting on today, before I bring them into the land that I swore [to give]."
en.B: And when many disasters and troubles overtake them, this song will speak against them as a witness, because their descendants will not forget it. I know what their hearts are inclined to do even now, before I have brought them into the land I swore to give them."
en.R: When many terrible troubles come on them, this song will stand up as a witness against them, because their descendants will still remember it. I know what they are planning to do, even today, before I bring them into the land I promised."

decisions.choice: testify: answer, speak as a witness
decisions.reason: The verb means to answer, and in a court to give evidence. The song will speak up against the people and show that their troubles are what God warned of.

decisions.choice: inclination: the bent of their thoughts and plans
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning to form or shape, and names what a person's mind is shaping, its plans and leanings (Genesis 6:5; 8:21).

decisions.choice: which it is doing today, before I bring it: already at work
decisions.reason: The bent toward unfaithfulness is not only in the future; it is at work already, before the people have entered the land.

decisions.choice: what their hearts are inclined to do
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "hearts", since the word speaks of the inner person.

decisions.choice: [to give] / to give
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ends with "I swore". English needs what God swore, as in verse 20.

source.text: וַיִּכְתֹּ֥ב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־הַשִּׁירָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַֽיְלַמְּדָ֖הּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And wrote Moses the song the this on the day the that and taught it [to] the sons of Israel.

en.L: So Moses wrote this song on that day and taught it to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: So Moses wrote down this song that same day and taught it to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: Moses wrote the song down that day and taught it to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

decisions.choice: this song: the Song of Moses in 32:1-43
decisions.reason: The song God told Moses to write (verse 19) is given in the next chapter. Verse 30 introduces it.

source.text: וַיְצַ֞ו אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֗וּן וַיֹּאמֶר֮ חֲזַ֣ק וֶֽאֱמָץ֒ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תָּבִיא֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לָהֶ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֖י אֶֽהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he commissioned Joshua son of Nun and said, be strong and be bold, for you will bring the sons of Israel into the land which I swore to them, and I will be with you.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} charged Joshua son of Nun and said, "Be strong and be courageous, for you shall bring the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel into the land that I swore to them, and I will be with you."
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commissioned Joshua son of Nun. He said, "Be strong and courageous. You are the one who will bring the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} into the land I swore to give them, and I will be with you."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave Joshua son of Nun his orders. He said, "Be strong and brave. You will lead the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} into the land I promised them, and I will be with you."

decisions.choice: he commissioned: the LORD
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not name the subject, and Moses was the last person named (verse 22). But the speaker says "the land that I swore" and "I will be with you", which only God can say, and in verse 14 God said he would commission Joshua at the tent. So the subject is the LORD.

decisions.choice: the land I swore ... I will be with you (the traditional Hebrew text)
alternatives: Moses commissioned Joshua: the land the LORD swore, and he will be with you (Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation makes Moses the one who commissions Joshua, and reads "the land the LORD swore to them, and he will be with you". The traditional Hebrew text has God speaking in the first person, and we follow it. This account of the evidence is from general knowledge and must be checked against the textual sources before review.

decisions.choice: be strong and courageous ... I will be with you
decisions.reason: God gives Joshua the charge Moses gave him in verse 7, with his own promise of presence. He repeats both when Joshua takes command (Joshua 1:5-9).

decisions.choice: the LORD
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the subject the Hebrew leaves unstated (see the meaning decision). Literal keeps "he".

source.text: וַיְהִ֣י׀כְּכַלּ֣וֹת מֹשֶׁ֗ה לִכְתֹּ֛ב אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַתּוֹרָֽה־הַזֹּ֖את עַל־סֵ֑פֶר עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when finished Moses to write [the] words of the law the this on a book until they were complete,

en.L: And it happened, when Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book to their end,
en.B: When Moses had finished writing out the words of this law in a book, to the very last word,
en.R: Moses finished writing all the words of this teaching on a scroll.

decisions.choice: a book: a written document, a scroll
decisions.reason: The word names any written document. A book of this kind was written on a scroll of leather or papyrus, not bound in pages (17:18; Jeremiah 36:2).

decisions.choice: until they were complete: all of it, to the end
decisions.reason: The phrase means Moses wrote the whole of it, leaving nothing out. The same phrase closes verse 30.

decisions.choice: and it happened, when Moses had finished: leading into verse 25
decisions.reason: The verse sets the time for what follows: once the writing was done, Moses gave his order to the Levites. Verse 9 already said that Moses wrote the law; this verse takes the story up again.

decisions.choice: scroll
decisions.reason: Readable says "scroll" so that readers picture the right kind of book, as in 17:18.

source.text: וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נֹ֥שְׂאֵ֛יאֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: then commanded Moses the Levites, carriers of [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh, saying,

en.L: that Moses commanded the Levites, the carriers of the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, saying,
en.B: he gave this order to the Levites, the bearers of the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}:
en.R: Then he gave an order to the Levites, whose job was to carry the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He said,

decisions.choice: the Levites who carried the ark: the priests of verse 9
decisions.reason: Verse 9 calls those who carry the ark "the priests, the sons of Levi". Deuteronomy speaks of priests and Levites together as the tribe set apart for this duty (10:8; 18:1).

source.text: לָקֹ֗חַ אֵ֣ת סֵ֤פֶר הַתּוֹרָה֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וְשַׂמְתֶּ֣ם אֹת֔וֹ מִצַּ֛ד אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָֽיָה־שָׁ֥ם בְּךָ֖ לְעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Take [the] book of the law the this and put it at [the] side of [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh your God, and it will be there against you as a witness.

en.L: "Take this book of the law and put it beside the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and it shall be there as a witness against you.
en.B: "Take this book of the law and set it next to the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. Let it stay there as a witness against you.
en.R: "Take this scroll of teaching and put it next to the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. It will stay there as a witness against you.

decisions.choice: beside the ark: next to it, not inside
decisions.reason: The ark held only the two stone tablets of the covenant (10:1-5; 1 Kings 8:9). The book of the law is kept beside it, in the most holy place, where it cannot be lost or changed.

decisions.choice: a witness against you: the written law as evidence
decisions.reason: Like the song (verse 19), the book will stand as a witness. If Israel breaks the covenant, the written words will show what they had been told. "You" is singular: Israel as one.

decisions.choice: take: an order
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the bare form of the verb as a command, a forceful way to give an order.

decisions.choice: scroll of teaching
decisions.reason: Readable says "scroll" (verse 24) and "teaching" (1:5).

source.text: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֤י יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֶֽת־מֶרְיְךָ֔ וְאֶֽת־עָרְפְּךָ֖ הַקָּשֶׁ֑ה הֵ֣ן בְּעוֹדֶנִּי֩ חַ֨י עִמָּכֶ֜ם הַיּ֗וֹם מַמְרִ֤ים הֱיִתֶם֙ עִם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְאַ֖ף כִּי־אַחֲרֵ֥י מוֹתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: For I, I know your rebellion and your neck the stiff; look, while I [am] still alive with you today, rebellious you have been with Yahweh, and how much more after my death!

en.L: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Look, while I am still alive with you today, you have been rebellious against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; how much more, then, after my death!
en.B: I know how rebellious and stubborn you are. Even now, while I am still alive and with you, you have been rebelling against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. How much more will you rebel after I am dead!
en.R: I know how you rebel and how stubborn you are. Even today, while I am still alive and here with you, you rebel against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. You will rebel even more after I die!

decisions.choice: stiff neck: stubbornness
decisions.reason: A stiff neck is the picture of an ox that will not bend to the yoke; it means stubborn refusal to obey (9:6, 13; Exodus 32:9).

decisions.choice: how much more: an argument from lesser to greater
decisions.reason: If the people rebel while Moses is still with them, they will rebel all the more when he is gone.

decisions.choice: you have been rebellious: Israel's record in the wilderness
decisions.reason: Moses has already said these words of Israel's whole journey (9:7, 24).

decisions.choice: stubborn
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "stiff neck" means. Literal keeps the picture.

source.text: הַקְהִ֧ילוּ אֵלַ֛י אֶת־כָּל־זִקְנֵ֥י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֖ם וְשֹׁטְרֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְאָזְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֔ם אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Assemble to me all [the] elders of your tribes and your officials, that I may speak in their ears the words the these, and I may call to witness against them the heavens and the earth.

en.L: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officials, that I may speak these words in their hearing and call the heavens and the earth to witness against them.
en.B: Gather to me all the elders of your tribes and your officials, so that I can speak these words for them to hear and call heaven and earth as witnesses against them.
en.R: Bring all the leaders of your tribes and your officials here to me. I want to tell them these things, and I will call on heaven and earth to be witnesses against them.

decisions.choice: officials: officers who carried out orders
decisions.reason: These were officers who served under the leaders and judges, keeping records and passing on orders (1:15; 16:18; 20:5).

decisions.choice: heaven and earth as witnesses
decisions.reason: In a covenant, witnesses were called to confirm it. Moses calls on heaven and earth, which last for all time (4:26; 30:19). The Song opens by calling them to listen (32:1).

decisions.choice: these words: the Song that follows
decisions.reason: The words Moses will speak to the assembly are the Song (verse 30; 32:1-43).

decisions.choice: leaders
decisions.reason: Readable calls the elders "leaders", as in verse 9.

source.text: כִּ֣י יָדַ֗עְתִּי אַחֲרֵ֤י מוֹתִי֙ כִּֽי־הַשְׁחֵ֣ת תַּשְׁחִת֔וּן וְסַרְתֶּ֣ם מִן־הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְקָרָ֨את אֶתְכֶ֤ם הָֽרָעָה֙ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֔ים כִּֽי־תַעֲשׂ֤וּ אֶת־הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְהַכְעִיס֖וֹ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For I know after my death that acting corruptly you will act corruptly and turn from the way which I have commanded you, and will meet you the evil in [the] latter [part] of the days, because you will do the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh to provoke him by [the] work of your hands.

en.L: For I know that after my death you will surely act corruptly and turn aside from the way that I have commanded you, and evil will meet you in the latter days, because you will do what is evil in the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, provoking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to anger with the work of your hands."
en.B: For I know that once I am dead you will become utterly corrupt and turn aside from the way I have commanded you. In days to come disaster will strike you, because you will do what is evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and provoke {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to anger by what your hands have made."
en.R: I know that after I die, you will become completely evil. You will turn away from the way of life I commanded you to follow. In the future, terrible trouble will come on you, because you will do what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says is evil. You will make {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} angry by worshiping idols you have made with your own hands."

decisions.choice: you will surely act corruptly: strong emphasis
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis. To act corruptly is to ruin oneself by turning to idols (4:16, 25).

decisions.choice: the latter days: the days to come
decisions.reason: The phrase means the future, the time after this (4:30). It does not here mean the end of the world.

decisions.choice: the work of your hands: idols
decisions.reason: In Deuteronomy "the work of human hands" often means idols of wood and stone (4:28; 27:15), and making idols is what provokes God to anger (4:25; 9:18). The phrase can also mean a person's deeds in general.

decisions.choice: by worshiping idols you have made with your own hands
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the work of your hands" points to (see the meaning decision). Literal and Balanced keep the wider phrase.

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֗ה בְּאָזְנֵי֙ כָּל־קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַשִּׁירָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And spoke Moses in [the] ears of all [the] assembly of Israel the words of the song the this until they were complete.

en.L: And Moses spoke in the hearing of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song to their end:
en.B: Then Moses recited the words of this song from beginning to end, while the whole assembly of Israel listened:
en.R: Then Moses spoke the words of this song to the whole assembly of Israel. He said all of it, from beginning to end:

decisions.choice: the words of this song: introduces 32:1-43
decisions.reason: The verse introduces the Song, which follows in the next chapter. It is the song God told Moses to write and teach (verses 19, 22).

decisions.choice: the assembly of Israel: the people gathered before Moses
decisions.reason: The word names Israel gathered together. The elders and officials of verse 28 stand for the whole people.

decisions.choice: from beginning to end
decisions.reason: "Until they were complete" means the whole song; Balanced and Readable say so in a common phrase. The rendering ends with a colon because the Song itself follows.
